features.name: CLI request intake
features.description: The line-oriented terminal accepts a natural-language harness request and reports the current application limits without implying that files were generated.
evidence: `uv run harness-creator` accepted a non-empty request and stated that this version does not create harness files.
`uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests` passed three tests for blank input retry, EOF, and interrupt handling.
`uv build` created the source distribution and wheel.

features.name: LLM provider abstraction
features.description: The product uses a shared provider-neutral interface with direct adapters for Ollama, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Meta's hosted API, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude; local Ollama is the default, with configurable provider and model and no silent provider fallback.

features.name: Requirements gathering and review
features.description: The product captures purpose, context, constraints, task types, and target; asks focused questions about missing or unclear information; and lets the user review and correct requirements before generation.

features.name: Session persistence and lifecycle
features.description: SQLite pause and resume restore complete session state; restart carries requirements and choices into a fresh editable session without drafts or deleting files.

features.name: Target-aware harness generation
features.description: The product generates a coherent set of files from confirmed requirements using supported task profiles, target conventions, and requested output formats, and identifies unsupported requirements.

features.name: Output validation and error reporting
features.description: The product validates generated files where checks are available, reports actionable failures and limitations, and does not present incomplete work as a complete harness.

features.name: Artifact access and write approval
features.description: The product identifies generated files and required setup, distinguishes generated and user-supplied content, and obtains approval before replacing or deleting user content.

features.name: Security and secret handling
features.description: The product protects session content and files from unauthorized access and does not expose secrets in messages, logs, examples, or generated files.

features.name: Data handling disclosure
features.description: The product accurately explains where session content is stored or sent and when it is removed, and discloses external services before sending user data.
